presence_plan: copy completed v3 presence checkpoint unchanged
character_change: 12404 entries: collision-free modern Hangul/jamo/ASCII; other Unicode characters retain a 512-bucket fallback. Each new entry inherits its own prior hash embedding before training.
selection: minimum full span validation loss; no selection on development or frozen audit tests
test_policy: v2 1120 and audit 120 are development regression. v3 frozen audit 96 has not been evaluated; compare only after completion.
causal_limit: Both name diversity and character representation change; without ablation, improvements cannot be attributed solely to character IDs.
scheduling: Independent CPU span-head job while the separate presence job uses MPS. Latency benchmarks wait until both finish.
